channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Gold rallies to over two-week high, eyes $4,150 as traders track US-Iran diplomacy efforts
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) rallies to an over two-week high, around the $4,140-$4,141 area, during the Asian session on Wednesday amid hopes that US-Iran diplomacy could ease energy prices and temper hawkish US Federal Reserve (Fed) expectations.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Tests ascending triangle top above 186.00
item.description: EUR/JPY extends its gains for the second successive day, trading around 186.20 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The currency cross is retaining a bullish near-term bias as it holds above both the nine-period and 50-period Exponential Moving Averages (EMAs).

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD rises to near $60.00 despite surging inflation fears
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) gains ground for the fourth successive day, trading around $59.70 per troy ounce during the Asian hours on Wednesday. Silver prices are surging despite rising rate-hike expectations, as powerful market forces outweigh the drag of higher interest rates.

item.title: US Secretary of State Rubio: Iranian control of Hormuz would have repercussions beyond Middle East
item.description: In Wednesday’s Asian session, the US Secretary of State Marco Rubio told Southeast Asian foreign ministers that Iranian control of the Strait of Hormuz, a vital passage to almost 20% of global energy supply, would set a dangerous precedent with repercussions beyond the Middle East.

item.title: United States Dollar Index weakens to near 101.00 despite mounting Middle East tensions
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), an index of the value of the US Dollar (USD) measured against a basket of six world currencies, currently trades near 101.15 in the Asian trading hours on Wednesday. The DXY declines amid US Federal Reserve (Fed) rate uncertainty.

item.title: US President Donald Trump approves US-Saudi Arabia nuclear deal
item.description: US President Donald Trump approved a landmark agreement with Saudi Arabia that could potentially provide the kingdom with uranium enrichment capability for its civilian nuclear program, the Wall Street Journal reported on Wednesday.

item.title: Yemen’s Houthis threaten Bab el-Mandeb closure, putting another trade chokepoint at risk
item.description: Yemen’s Houthis said that they have closed the Bab el-Mandeb Strait to Saudi-linked shipping in retaliation for the kingdom’s blockade on Yemen and a recent attack on the international airport in Yemen’s rebel-held capital, Sanaa, the Guardian reported on Wednesday.

item.title: US CENTCOM says it has completed 11th night of strikes on Iran
item.description: The United States Central Command (CENTCOM) said that it completed another night of attacks that targeted “military operations centers, maritime capabilities, aircraft hangars, drone storage facilities, and military logistics infrastructure to further degrade Iran’s ability to threaten commercial sh

item.title: UK CPI set to show receding inflation in June as GBP/USD fails at May highs
item.description: The UK Office for National Statistics (ONS) will release the June Consumer Price Index (CPI) figures on Wednesday at 06:00 GMT, a print that will matter for markets. Consensus expectations point to inflation pressures still above the Bank of England’s (BoE) target, although losing further momentum.

item.title: Canadian Dollar edges higher amid bullish oil prices; upside potential seems limited
item.description: The USD/CAD pair struggles to capitalize on its strong weekly gains registered over the past two days and edges lower during the Asian session on Wednesday. Spot prices currently trade around the 1.4100 round figure, though the fundamental backdrop warrants caution for aggressive bearish traders.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar declines as safe-haven demand lifts US Dollar
item.description: NZD/USD depreciates after opening at a bullish gap, remaining in the positive territory and trading around 0.5830 during the Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: Australian Dollar strengthens above 0.7000 on RBA hawkish stance
item.description: The AUD/USD pair gathers strength to near 0.7010 during the early Asian trading hours on Wednesday. The Australian Dollar (AUD) strengthens against the US Dollar (USD) as the likelihood of the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) interest rate hike rises.

item.title: Japan’s Katayama says will take necessary steps on forex as required
item.description: Japan’s Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said on Wednesday that the authorities will take necessary steps on the foreign exchange if necessary.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.7933 vs. 6.7917 previous
item.description: On Wednesday, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead at 6.7933 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.7917 and 6.7737 Reuters estimate.

item.title: Japanese Yen bears turn cautious near four-decade low amid looming intervention risks
item.description: The USD/JPY enters a bullish consolidation phase during the Asian session on Wednesday and holds steady above the 163.00 mark, near its highest level since 1986 set the previous day.

item.title: WTI rises above $84.50 as escalating global supply risks threaten key export hubs
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price gains ground for the second successive day, trading around $84.60 per barrel during the Asian hours on Wednesday. Crude oil prices surge as supply risks intensified across several key export routes, extending well beyond the Middle East.

item.title: Euro holds gains above 1.1400 on hawkish ECB expectations despite US-Iran tensions
item.description: The EUR/USD pair trades with mild gains around 1.1405 during the early Asian session on Wednesday. A hawkish tone from the European Central Bank (ECB) provides some support to the Euro (EUR) against the US Dollar (USD). Traders await the upcoming ECB interest rate decision on Thursday.

item.title: Iran says interests of US and its allies will be targeted if US strikes Iran's nuclear sites
item.description: Iran's top joint military command said that Tehran will expand its strikes and target the US and its allies' interests across the region if the US attacks Iran's nuclear sites, Xinhua news agency reported on Tuesday.

item.title: Gold rebounds above $4,050 as safe-haven demand intensified on persistent US‑Iran tensions
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) gains ground to around $4,080 during the early Asian session on Wednesday. The precious metal rebounds as safe-haven demand intensified globally after retreating to the $4,000 psychological level in the previous session.

item.title: British Pound Sterling gets a decent jobs report and sells off anyway
item.description: The British Pound received a labour market report on Tuesday that beat consensus on nearly every line, and sold off anyway.

item.title: GBP/JPY Price Forecast: Holds above 218.00 bulls eye YTD peak
item.description: The GBP/JPY consolidates around 218.20 as the Pound Sterling loses momentum amid the new PM, Andy Burnham, taking office. Fears of a possible intervention by Japanese authorities capped the cross-pair advance, which remains trading near year-to-date (YTD) highs seen on July 15.

item.title: The Australian Dollar goes nowhere with conviction
item.description: The Australian Dollar spent Tuesday doing a convincing impression of movement, climbing from just below the 0.7000 handle to a session high short of 0.7050 before handing the entire advance back through the North American afternoon.

item.title: Chinese Yuan: Upside bias holds near 6.7600 against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s Quek Ser Leang notes that USD/CNH retains a downside bias in both the 24-hour and 1–3 week horizons, with key support around 6.7600 and strong resistance at 6.7820.

item.title: Forex Today: US Dollar rises as Middle East tensions lift Oil
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) advances on Tuesday as escalating tensions between the United States (US) and Iran push energy prices higher and revive concerns that inflation could remain elevated. The Greenback also benefits from safe-haven demand despite softer US inflation and employment indicators.

item.title: Federal Reserve seen holding rates next week amid Oil shock ‒ Reuters
item.description: A Reuters poll revealed that the Federal Reserve is most likely to keep interest rates unchanged for the rest of the year as it battles stubbornly high inflation that has remained above the Fed’s 2% goal for at least 5 years.

item.title: China: National team support shapes flows – BNY
item.description: BNY’s Geoff Yu highlights how China’s regulators and state-backed funds have stepped in to stabilize A-shares after global tech deleveraging hit domestic markets.

item.title: Japanese Yen tumbles to 40-year low as US Dollar safe-haven rush deepens
item.description: The USD/JPY extends its rally on Tuesday, hitting 40-year highs above 163.00 as the Greenback continues to gain ground versus the Japanese Yen. At the time of writing, the USD/JPY trades at 163.19, slightly shy of the multi-decade high of 163.24.

item.title: South Korean Won: Support cluster near 1,464/1,461 – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale’s technical team notes USD/KRW failed twice to break above the June high around 1,561, triggering a deeper decline towards the 200-day moving average. The pair is now testing this key MA, with next support at a multi-month ascending trend line near 1,464/1,461.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG to break resistance trendline, eyes on $60
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) surges over 4.50% on Tuesday, reaching five-day highs, clearing $59.00 as buyers push the white metal to test a downslope resistance trendline near the $59.65/$50.75 range, about to surpass the $60.00 mark.

item.title: Canada's Loonie meets another 50% tariff
item.description: USD/CAD trades just above the 1.4100 handle into the North American afternoon, up around a fifth of one percent and on track for a second consecutive daily advance.
